blocks.text: Houston Eyeglass FAQs: Warranties, Wait Times, and Care Tips
blocks.html: [[b]]Houston Eyeglass FAQs: Warranties, Wait Times, and Care Tips[[/b]]

If you've recently picked out a new pair of glasses, you're probably wondering what happens next. At[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eyeglass-basics/"]] Briargrove Eye Center[[/a]], our Houston optometrists answer questions like: [[i]]How long will it take to get my glasses?[[/i]] [[i]]What’s the warranty policy?[[/i]] [[i]]How do I clean my lenses properly?[[/i]]
This guide walks you through the full post-purchase experience — so you can protect your investment and enjoy clear vision faster.

blocks.text: How Long Does It Take to Get Glasses?
blocks.html: [[b]]How Long Does It Take to Get Glasses?[[/b]]

On average, glasses are ready for pickup in [[b]]7 to 10 business days[[/b]]. This timeline covers standard lenses and frames available through our[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eyeglasses/"]] optical boutique[[/a]].

items: [[b]]Out-of-stock frame sizes[[/b]], your order might take slightly longer due to lab production times or shipping delays.

blocks.html: Tip: Ask your optician during checkout for an estimate based on your specific order.

blocks.text: What’s Included in My Glasses Warranty?

blocks.html: We provide a [[b]]1-year manufacturer’s warranty[[/b]] on both lenses and frames:

items: [[b]]Frame Coverage:[[/b]] Manufacturer defects such as loose hinges or structural failure without physical damage.
[[b]]Lens Coverage:[[/b]] Scratches, defects, or issues with anti-reflective coatings under normal use.

blocks.html: [[b]]Not covered:[[/b]] Accidental damage, such as bent frames from impact or broken arms from drops.
For full peace of mind, ask our team during your next[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/comprehensive-eye-exams/"]] comprehensive eye exam[[/a]] about optional protection plans.

blocks.text: Best Way to Clean and Care for Your Glasses
blocks.html: [[b]]Best Way to Clean and Care for Your Glasses[[/b]]
Caring for your glasses the right way can extend their lifespan and maintain crystal-clear vision. Here's how we recommend cleaning your lenses:

items: [[b]]Always use a microfiber cloth or 100% cotton.[[/b]] Avoid paper towels, tissues, or clothing, which can scratch lenses.
[[b]]Weekly deep clean:[[/b]] Mix lukewarm water with a drop of Dawn® dish soap. Gently lather and rinse, then dry with microfiber.
[[b]]Disinfection:[[/b]] Use an alcohol swab, followed by a clean microfiber cloth to prevent streaking.
[[b]]Avoid over-wiping.[[/b]] Excessive cleaning can wear down the lens coating over time, leaving smudges or rings.

blocks.html: Need supplies? Visit our[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eyeglasses/"]] Houston optical boutique[[/a]] — we carry professional lens cleaning kits and sprays approved by our eye care team.

blocks.text: Final Thought: Ask Early, Book Ahead

blocks.html: Questions are always welcome, whether you're a new patient or a longtime member of the Briargrove Eye Center family. We’re here to help you choose the right[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/designer-frames/"]] designer frames[[/a]] and understand how to care for them properly.

Want to make the most of your visit? We recommend scheduling your next eye exam in advance — especially during the busy back-to-school and end-of-year periods. You can easily[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/"]] book an appointment online[[/a]] or by phone.
